title: SpaceBuildFiles
description: space.build-files@1: the source files of one of a person's spaces, as their agent sees them (OpenVibe.Space's builder API; plan 2026-10-22 §Z stage Z1). GET /api/v1/spaces/:id/files answers { files }: every file of the space, its path and its whole content. The same shape is the body of PUT /api/v1/spaces/:id/files (space.build-write@1): the files to write, which replace the space's files as a whole.

path.description: The file's path inside the space: letters, digits, ".", "-", "_", up to four folders.
